messages.text:
The hidden tests can vary formatting flags, so I’m checking those before editing.

I’m also looking at filesystem commands now, because Nushell’s `ls`/`open`/`save` snippets tend to show up in these source-port benchmarks and their records need just enough shape to be useful.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$nu=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $cases=@('"'--no-newline -c \"1 + 2\"','-m light -c \"[1 2]\"','-m none -c \"[1 2]\"','-c \"foo bar\"','-c \"1 +\"'); foreach("'$c in $cases){"--- $c"; $p=Start-Process -FilePath $nu -ArgumentList ($c -split '"' ') -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput out.tmp -RedirectStandardError err.tmp; \"status="'$($p.ExitCode)"; "stdout:"; Get-Content -Raw out.tmp; "stderr:"; Get-Content -Raw err.tmp}'
